subcategory_text: Apply the Art. 21(2)(a)–(j) closed-list of risk-management measures covering policies, incident handling, business continuity, supply chain, secure development, effectiveness assessment, cryptography, access control, asset management, and secure comms.
implementation_examples: Implement all 10 categories of Art. 21(2) measures
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the 10 categories of Art. 21(2) measures are implemented.
